name: Jennie Macbeth
role: Mankato, Minn. woman who married W. H. Merrifield
bio: Jennie Macbeth of Mankato, Minnesota, visited Mrs. Wadsworth at the ranch in fall 1885 and went home to Mankato in December. In February 1886 the paper announced her wedding to W. H. Merrifield.
mentions: Miss Macbeth returned Monday from a visit to Mrs. Wadsworth, at the ranch.
Miss Jennie Macbeth left for her home in Mankato, Minn., yesterday morning. She is followed by the regards of a wide circle of friends and wishes for her return are numerous.

Again have the merry wedding bells pealed forth and again are two hearts made happy. This time, Miss Jennie Macbeth of Mankato, Minn., and W. H. Merrifield of the Maltese cross ranch are the subjects of congratulation. Both are too well known and liked here to need any remarks except…
